prompt: Review whether Ginkgo Bioworks has a material causal relationship to AI-native drug-discovery platforms using current primary evidence; accept or reject the edge.

inputs.proposed_mechanism: Ginkgo's biological data and automated wet-lab infrastructure could supply faster design-make-test-learn loops to drug-discovery customers if those tools produce repeatable partner economics.
inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject or invalidate the edge if drug-discovery exposure is immaterial, customers internalize the workflow, or platform activity fails to produce repeatable revenue and customer outcomes.
